questions.question: What role of Ezekiel is renewed in chapter 33?
options: Watchman for the house of Israel
High priest of the new temple
questions.answer: Watchman for the house of Israel

questions.question: What news reached Ezekiel in chapter 33?
options: An angel from heaven announced that the long exile would soon end
A prophet of the LORD declared that mighty Babylon had at last fallen
A weary messenger brought word of a great and coming famine
A fugitive reported that the city (Jerusalem) had fallen
questions.answer: A fugitive reported that the city (Jerusalem) had fallen

questions.question: God says he has no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but that the wicked turn from his way and live.
If the watchman sees the sword coming and fails to blow the _____, the blood is on the watchman.
As I live, declares the Lord GOD, I have no pleasure in the death of the _____.
